column1: # The generic SLMP device table. Family-neutral: which of these a given CPU actually
# HAS lives in ranges_iqf.tsv / ranges_iqr.tsv, and the iQ-F octal override for X and Y
# lives in the profile, not here. `radix` is the DEFAULT radix of the device number as
# unit            bit | word. words_per_point is 2 for the long (dword) devices, so a
#                 single LTN/LSTN/LCN/LZ point spans two words of response.
# min_spec        short = reachable with subcommand 0000/0001 (1-byte code, 3-byte
#                 number). long = only reachable with 0002/0003 (2-byte code, 4-byte
#                 number), which an FX5U rejects outright with 0xC059 (measured).
# code_short      the 1-byte binary device code. code_long is the 2-byte form.
# ascii2/ascii4   the ASCII MNEMONIC, padded with '*' (0x2A). ASCII never sends the hex
#                 of the code: D is "D*"/"D***", never "A8".
# random_ok       false for the contacts and coils. FX5-SLMP p.78 says Read Random must
#                 not be used with them and predicts CPU error 0x4032 -- but an
#                 FX5U-32MT/DS fw 1.065 ACCEPTED a TS0 word point and answered 0x0000
#                 with data. This column is therefore load-bearing client-side
#                 validation, not a restatement of what the PLC will refuse.
# batch_ok        false for the long timer / long retentive timer / long index devices,
#                 which have no meaningful batch (word-unit) reading.
